Scenario fixture: a11ycore-input-image-alt-present (“<input type="image"> must have an alt attribute”)

This file includes edge cases to test eligibility and whole-rule outcomes. Each test input has a stable id of the form input_image_case_XX.

A. Baseline (eligible)

01 — FAIL: visible input-image missing alt
Missing alt.
02 — PASS: input-image with non-empty alt
Has alt.
03 — PASS (for this atomic rule): input-image with empty alt=""
Empty alt allowed here.

B. aria-hidden (eligible if focusable exception applies)

04 — FAIL: aria-hidden="true" (still focusable), missing alt
Focusable => eligibility override => applicable.
05 — INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden="true" and disabled, missing alt
Not focusable; not IDREF-referenced; ineligible.

C. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

06 — INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute (missing alt)
Ineligible per helper.
07 — INELIGIBLE: display:none (missing alt)
Ineligible per helper.
08 — INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden (missing alt)
Ineligible per helper.

D. Inertness (ineligible)

09 — INELIGIBLE: ancestor inert (missing alt)
Ineligible per helper.

E. Conditions that should NOT exclude eligibility (per engine guardrails)

10 — FAIL (eligible): disabled, missing alt
Disabled does not exclude eligibility; missing alt should fail.
11 — FAIL (eligible): opacity:0, missing alt
Opacity does not exclude eligibility.
12 — FAIL (eligible): offscreen, missing alt
Offscreen does not exclude eligibility.
13 — FAIL (eligible): zero-size container, missing alt
Zero-size does not exclude eligibility.

F. ARIA naming mechanism (aria-label / aria-labelledby satisfy without alt)

14 — PASS: input-image with aria-label, no alt
ARIA naming (aria-label) satisfies the mechanism without alt.
15 — PASS: input-image with aria-labelledby referencing non-empty text, no alt
Submit form label
16 — FAIL: input-image with aria-labelledby pointing to non-existent id, no alt
Dangling IDREF does not resolve to a name; alt is also missing.
17 — FAIL: input-image with aria-label="" (empty), no alt
Empty aria-label does not satisfy ARIA naming; alt is also missing.

G. Visibility inheritance (invertible via explicit descendant override)

18 — FAIL (eligible): ancestor visibility:hidden, input-image itself explicitly visibility:visible, missing alt
The input's own computed visibility is "visible" (explicit override), so it remains eligible despite the hidden ancestor.
19 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: ancestor visibility:hidden, input-image inherits (no override), missing alt
No explicit override; the input inherits visibility:hidden and stays ineligible.

End of fixture.
